chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a launderer to whom I gave a garment, and he claimed that it was stolen from among his clothes. He said: He must establish proof that it was stolen from among his belongings, and there is nothing upon him; and if it was stolen together with his belongings, then there is nothing upon him.

key_terms.ثَوْبًا: a garment given into another person's custody
key_terms.سُرِقَ: was stolen, indicating loss through theft rather than direct negligence
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: liability or compensable responsibility in this context
key_terms.قَصَّارٍ: a launderer or cloth-washer entrusted with garments
key_terms.مَتَاعِهِ: his belongings or property among which the item was kept
key_terms.ٱلْبَيِّنَةَ: legal proof or evidence establishing the claim

ai.seo_question: Is a launderer liable if a customer's garment is stolen while in his possession?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the liability of a worker entrusted with someone else's property. If the launderer proves that the garment was genuinely stolen from among his own belongings, or it was stolen together with his property, he is not held liable for compensation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3925 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:

I asked him about a launderer to whom I gave a garment, and he claimed that it was stolen from among his belongings.
Imam (as) said: "He must provide evidence that it was stolen from among his belongings, and if he does so, then he is not liable. Similarly, if it was stolen along with his belongings, he is not liable."
